body.title: docs: add SQL support matrix to README
body.body: ## Summary Adds a comprehensive SQL Support Matrix table to the README, addressing #140. ### What this adds - A clear feature matrix table placed between the Features section and Project Structure - Status for all implemented SQL features: CREATE TABLE, INSERT, SELECT (projection/aliases), WHERE operators (comparison, logical, LIKE, IN, BETWEEN), ORDER BY, LIMIT, UPDATE, DELETE, SHOW TABLES, DESCRIBE, DROP TABLE, ASK - Status for planned features: JOIN, Subqueries, DISTINCT, Aggregates, GROUP BY/HAVING, UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT - Version tags showing when each feature was introduced - Links from planned items to ROADMAP.md - Consistent status labels (Implemented / Planned) with emoji indicato…
